cases.sentence: Когда в ___ он был в состоянии говорить, одна Варя, жена брата, была в его комнате.
cases.explain: «первый раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Vronsky’s wound had been a dangerous one, though it did not touch the heart, and for several days he had lain between life and death. The first time he was able to speak, Varya, his brother’s wife, was alone in the room.

cases.sentence: Не отвечая на его слова, Варя нагнулась над ним и с ___ посмотрела ему в лицо.
cases.explain: «радостной улыбкой» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Without answering his words, Varya bent over him, and with a delighted smile gazed into his face. His eyes were clear, not feverish; but their expression was stern.

cases.sentence: Он, молча сжав свои ___, смотрел на нее, пока она перевязывала его.
cases.explain: «широкие скулы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In silence, stiffening his broad jaws, he looked at her while she bandaged him up. When she had finished he said:

cases.sentence: «Один раз увидать ее и потом зарыться, умереть», – думал он и, делая ___, высказал эту мысль Бетси.
cases.explain: «прощальные визиты» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “To see her once and then to bury myself, to die,” he thought, and as he was paying farewell visits, he uttered this thought to Betsy. Charged with this commission, Betsy had gone to Anna, and brought him back a negative reply.

cases.sentence: Он вбежал на лестницу, никого и ничего не видя, и ___, едва удерживаясь от бега, вошел в ее комнату.
cases.explain: «быстрым шагом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Without even troubling himself to see Betsy out of his flat, forgetting all his resolutions, without asking when he could see her, where her husband was, Vronsky drove straight to the Karenins’. He ran up the stairs seeing no one and nothing, and with a rapid step, almost breaking into a run, he went into her room. And without considering, without noticing whether there was anyone in the room or not, he flung his arms round her, and began to cover her face, her hands, her neck with kisses.

cases.sentence: – Я не узнаю тебя с этими ___.
cases.explain: «короткими волосами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “I don’t know you with this short hair. You’ve grown so pretty. A boy. But how pale you are!”

cases.sentence: Отказаться от лестного и опасного назначения в Ташкент, по ___ Вронского, было бы позорно и невозможно.
cases.explain: «прежним понятиям» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: To decline the flattering and dangerous appointment at Tashkend would have been, Vronsky had till then considered, disgraceful and impossible. But now, without an instant’s consideration, he declined it, and observing dissatisfaction in the most exalted quarters at this step, he immediately retired from the army.
